fusions.name: Swung Between
fusions.desc: Flings a barbed tine that deals 4 damage, then swings on to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Vaulting Jab
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and strike it, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Handhold Leap
fusions.desc: Plants the haft and vaults you 5 tiles forward.

fusions.name: Pocketed Breath
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you restore 5 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
